sourceNotes.rawContent:
- A perfect blend of sentiment and style, this necklace features two delicate chains with a heart and an initial pendant. It's the perfect way to express your personal story or give a thoughtful gift.
-
- Premium Quality | Anti-Tarnish
- Base Material: Stainless Steel
- Plating: 18K Gold-Plated
- Shape: Initial and Heart
- Size: One-size & Adjustable
- Net Quantity: 1
- Designed to complement both casual and formal outfits effortlessly
- Care Tips:
-
- Wipe with a soft cloth after every use
- Avoid contact with harsh chemicals, sprays, and perfumes
- Store in a flat box to prevent scratches
- Do not soak in water
sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Anti Tarnish Personalized Initial and Heart Necklace

notes: personalized is left null deliberately: the title says "Personalized Initial" and the description sells "an initial pendant" that expresses "your personal story", which is explicit personalisation language — but the export carries NO initial-selection option or variant, so how a shopper chooses the letter is unknown. Owner must resolve at review: if buyers pick an initial, this needs an option/variant design before publish (personalized: true); if it ships one fixed letter, personalized: false and the title overpromises.

2026-08-25: Base material and Plating candidates merged into one maximal-phrase Material attribute (contiguous source bullets quoted together). The karat claim ("18K") is dropped from the published value: karat-on-plated is not a claim this catalogue may make (ADR-018/ADR-035). The quote preserves the source's exact wording.

2026-08-25: owner-instructed batch confirmation (explicit publish-now decision) — every candidate attribute, the category (extraction PROPOSALS included) and personalized confirmed exactly as extracted, without per-product review. Contradictions flagged in earlier notes remain open items the owner will resolve post-publish, by their stated preference.

2026-08-25: pricing.price set to ₹209, matching the reference price per the pilot's reference-price-becomes-real-price rule; pricing.cost ₹125 is the ADR-040 placeholder convention (60% of price) pending real owner cost figures; pricing.mrp stays null by design, so the mapped record shows no discount.

2026-08-25: image suggestions auto-confirmed under the owner's migrated-path (Path A) decision established for the pilot and applied pipeline-wide: image linkage was mapped by the owner directly from the original live website and is independently verified, so per-product manual image review is waived for migrated batches.
